basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is recruiting for 1 vacancy for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post under advertisement number IITD/IRD/291/2026. The engagement is project-based on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, offering a pay range of Rs. 47,790 - Rs. 62,350 per month. plus HRA @ 30%. qualification.details: First-Class Master's and Bachelor's Degrees in any discipline from a recognized university or institute.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill out the form completely with required information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division, details of work experience, etc.
Mention Advertisement No.: IITD/IRD/291/2026 on the subject line of the email.
Send the completed application by email to Prof. Anil Verma at email id: [email protected].
Ensure the submission reaches by 30/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) at a Glance
Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post under the International Programmes project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational and experience requirements specified for the project appointment. First-Class Master's and Bachelor's Degrees in any discipline from a recognized university or institute. At least 08 years of administrative experience after obtaining the Bachelor's Degree. Knowledge of office procedures, rules and regulations operating in government organization or in educational organization. Candidates with apprenticeship training or experience. A good working knowledge of computer especially MS-Office/Job Res.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is made on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The consolidated fellowship ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month plus HRA @ 30% based on the pay-slab progression. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post. Their name will be displayed on the web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting completed applications by email is 30/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates require a First-Class Master's and Bachelor's Degree in any discipline along with at least 08 years of administrative experience after obtaining the Bachelor's Degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month plus HRA @ 30%.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website, fill it completely, and email it along with the advertisement number on the subject line to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is the post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (upto 05/11/2028), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the shortlist and interview details be displayed?
faq.answer: The short-listed candidates' names and online interview details will be displayed on the web link http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, a 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.
